nodes.label: Font Size Down Icon
nodes.description: Toolbar/UI icon depicting a capital letter 'T' next to a downward-pointing arrow. Represents the action of decreasing the displayed font size in the E-Tipitaka reader interface.

nodes.label: Decrease Font Size Action
nodes.rationale: Provides users with accessibility/readability control to shrink Tipitaka text rendering. Pairs with a complementary 'font size up' control for symmetric zoom-style typography adjustment.
